scope: P0-04B2 Fabrication Decomposition V0 observed-only; no Production, Color Layer, Material, Repair, or hidden geometry

fixtureApplicability.rationale: Simple flat crescent is valuable for V0 identity and boundary preservation but contains no clear hidden continuation evidence.
Envelope body, flap, and seal provide explicit multi-level overlay candidates for later human-authored piece/overlap GT.
Mooncake top, side wall, centre, and radial details provide layered geometry with near-color boundaries that must remain independent.
Repeated petals, front/rear petal structure, lamp bowl, and flame provide the strongest current overlap and physical-piece candidate.
Fuse, caps, and body test thin observed pieces, but current GT does not define a reliable hidden continuation target.
Rabbit silhouette, ears, face, and limb markings are useful for piece hierarchy review, while existing GT explicitly marks the case hard/ambiguous.
Window-flower holes strongly test topology-preserving V0 pieces but do not provide a validated occluded-shape continuation target.
Lantern body, cap, accent, and tassel provide a compact structured candidate for overlap and continuation review.

datasetGap.effect: B2-V0 can freeze an observed-only baseline; B2-V1 hidden reconstruction is not yet authorized.
